name: 34987 · Port St Lucie, FL
findings: ZIP 34987 (Port St Lucie) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34987 (Port St Lucie) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34987 (Port St Lucie) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
